name: Python
why_it_matters: Python is the dominant language for backend development, AI/ML, and automation with a massive ecosystem.

name: JavaScript
why_it_matters: The universal language of the web, essential for interactive frontend UIs and full-stack Node.js environments.

name: TypeScript
why_it_matters: Adds type safety and scalability to large modern codebases, drastically reducing runtime bugs.

name: React
why_it_matters: The industry standard UI library for building dynamic, responsive single-page applications and component architectures.

name: FastAPI
why_it_matters: High-performance, modern Python async web framework with automatic OpenAPI documentation and type validation.

name: Node.js
why_it_matters: Enables non-blocking event-driven backend services and unifying full-stack development under one language.

name: REST APIs
why_it_matters: The architectural backbone for client-server communication, microservices, and modern web integrations.

name: SQL & Relational Databases
why_it_matters: Essential for querying, joining, aggregating, and structuring business-critical persistent application data.

name: PostgreSQL
why_it_matters: The enterprise open-source database renowned for reliability, complex transactions, ACID compliance, and JSON support.

name: MongoDB
why_it_matters: Popular document-oriented NoSQL database ideal for flexible schemas, rapid prototyping, and hierarchical payloads.

name: Redis
why_it_matters: Blazing-fast in-memory cache and message broker for low-latency session management and rate limiting.

name: Docker & Containerization
why_it_matters: Ensures software runs identically across local machines, CI environments, and production cloud clusters.

name: Git & Version Control
why_it_matters: Foundational requirement for collaborative coding, branching strategies, code reviews, and release tagging.

name: CI/CD & GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Automates automated testing, linting, building, and seamless zero-downtime deployments upon git pushes.

name: AWS Cloud
why_it_matters: The leading public cloud provider for deploying scalable web applications, serverless functions, and storage.

name: Tailwind CSS
why_it_matters: Enables rapid, consistent, highly customized responsive UI styling directly inside component markup.

name: HTML5 & Modern CSS
why_it_matters: The structural and styling foundation of every browser document and responsive interface.

name: Linux & Bash Scripting
why_it_matters: Powers over 90% of cloud servers; command-line fluency is indispensable for debugging and automating environments.

name: Unit Testing & QA
why_it_matters: Ensures software stability, prevents regression errors, and enables safe rapid code refactoring.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
why_it_matters: Critical for software engineering technical interviews and building memory/time-efficient architectures.

name: Machine Learning
why_it_matters: Provides algorithmic ability to learn patterns from historical data and make intelligent predictions.

name: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
why_it_matters: Empowers computers to understand, interpret, extract insights, and manipulate human language.

name: Sentence Transformers & LLMs
why_it_matters: The core modern technique for vector embeddings, semantic search, RAG pipelines, and generative AI.

name: System Design & Architecture
why_it_matters: Essential for architecting scalable, resilient, highly available production systems handling heavy traffic.

name: GraphQL
why_it_matters: Allows frontend clients to query exactly the data fields they need in a single round trip.

name: Microservices
why_it_matters: Decouples large software into independently deployable, modular services maintained by dedicated teams.
